primary_statement.source: Hugo Duminil-Copin, Lectures on the Ising and Potts models on the hypercubic lattice, Conjecture 2, printed page 93
primary_statement.scope: For every integer q>=3 and d>=3, unit simplex-spin Potts on Z^d has positive monochromatic-boundary spontaneous magnetization at beta_c. In the standard color Hamiltonian H=-sum 1{same color}, K=beta*q/(q-1), p=1-exp(-K), and the normalized magnetization is M(K)=(q*mu_K^1(sigma_0=1)-1)/(q-1)=phi^wired_{p,q}(0<->infinity). The target is M(K_c)>0.

verified_partial_results.source: Biskup and Chayes, Rigorous analysis of discontinuous phase transitions via mean-field bounds, arXiv:math/0207242
verified_partial_results.scope: Nearest-neighbor reflection-positive models; fixed integer q>=3 with dimension sufficiently large. Main comparison (1.12) applies to extreme thermodynamic support pairs and includes error J*n*kappa*I_d/2. For Potts n=q-1,kappa=(q-1)/q. Theorem 2.1 locates a jump J_t and explicitly does not conclude exact vanishing below J_t. This neither certifies all d>=3 nor automatically identifies J_t with critical ordering onset.
